description:
Attach one observed outcome to a Wu Wei decision. Actual cost,
    latency, and energy are optional and remain explicitly unknown when
    omitted. One append-only, hash-bound outcome is allowed per decision.

actual_cost_usd.description: Optional. What the task actually cost, in US dollars.
actual_cost_usd.title: Actual Cost Usd

decision_id.description: The decision id returned by route_task.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes on the outcome.
notes.title: Notes

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

success_score.description: How well the task went, 0 to 1.
success_score.title: Success Score

name: record_route_outcome
title: Record route outcome
